description: Verify that a guest registers a Farm Owner account with a new email. [UC-FE01-01 main flow; TC-01-11]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Enter Họ và tên = "Nguyễn Văn Test", Email = "{email mới 1}", Mật khẩu = Xác nhận mật khẩu = <valid 12-char password>. 3. Click "Tạo tài khoản". 4. Tick "Tôi đã đọc và đồng ý với Điều khoản sử dụng và Chính sách dữ liệu của BeefCare.". 5. Click "Đồng ý và xác nhận". 6. Open the verification email, click the link. 7. Enter Số điện thoại liên hệ = "0912345678". 8. Click "Hoàn tất và đăng ký trang trại".
expected_results: 1. Dialog "Điều khoản và chính sách" opens; "Đồng ý và xác nhận" is disabled until ticked. 2. Page "Xác minh email" shows {email mới 1}; one email received. MSG-FE01-04 3. Farm registration screen opens; user is signed in.
precondition: 1. Test mailbox {email mới 1} is readable and not yet registered.

description: Verify that a guest cannot register with an email that already exists. [UC-FE01-01 exception flow; TC-01-12]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Enter Họ và tên = "Nguyễn Văn Trùng", Email = "Owner@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = Xác nhận mật khẩu = <valid password>. 3. Click "Tạo tài khoản". 4. Tick "Tôi đã đọc và đồng ý với Điều khoản sử dụng và Chính sách dữ liệu của BeefCare.". 5. Click "Đồng ý và xác nhận". 6. Click "Đăng nhập" link in the error.
expected_results: 1. Form shows "Email này đã có tài khoản BeefCare. Hãy đăng nhập hoặc dùng chức năng quên mật khẩu." MSG-FE01-10 2. No verification email; no second account. 3. Sign-in page opens with the email filled.
precondition: 1. Account owner@beefcare.test exists.

description: Verify that a guest sees required errors when all fields are empty. [UC-FE01-01 exception flow; TC-01-02]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Leave all fields empty. 3. Click "Tạo tài khoản".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 under each empty field ("Vui lòng nhập họ và tên." / "…email." / "…mật khẩu." / "Vui lòng xác nhận mật khẩu."). 2. Terms dialog does not open.
precondition: 1. No account is signed in.

description: Verify that a guest sees field errors for invalid email and passwords. [UC-FE01-01 exception flow; TC-01-03, TC-01-05, TC-01-06]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Enter Họ và tên = "A", Email = "abc@", Mật khẩu = "1234567", Xác nhận mật khẩu = "12345678". 3. Click "Tạo tài khoản". 4. Enter Email = "khach01@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = Xác nhận mật khẩu = "khach01@beefcare.test". 5. Click "Tạo tài khoản". 6. Enter Mật khẩu = <valid password>, Xác nhận mật khẩu = <different password>. 7. Click "Tạo tài khoản".
expected_results: 1. Step 3: MSG-COM-10 "Họ và tên cần từ 2 đến 100 ký tự.", "Email không hợp lệ."; MSG-FE01-08 "Mật khẩu cần từ 8 đến 128 ký tự."; MSG-FE01-09. 2. Step 5: MSG-FE01-08 "Mật khẩu không được trùng với email." 3. Step 7: MSG-FE01-09 "Mật khẩu xác nhận chưa khớp."; terms dialog never opens.
precondition: 1. No account is signed in.

description: Verify that closing the terms dialog does not create an account. [UC-FE01-01 exception flow; TC-01-07]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Enter Họ và tên = "Nguyễn Văn Test", Email = "{email mới 2}", Mật khẩu = Xác nhận mật khẩu = <valid 12-char password>. 3. Click "Tạo tài khoản". 4. Do not tick; check "Đồng ý và xác nhận". 5. Click X to close the dialog. 6. Go to page "Đăng nhập". 7. Enter Email = "{email mới 2}", Mật khẩu = <the password above>. 8. Click "Đăng nhập".
expected_results: 1. "Đồng ý và xác nhận" is disabled. MSG-FE01-14 2. Dialog closes; still on register page; no "Xác minh email". 3. Sign-in shows "Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa chính xác." MSG-FE01-01; no email received.
precondition: 1. {email mới 2} is not registered.

description: Verify that resending the verification email invalidates the old link. [UC-FE01-01 alternative flow; TC-01-15, TC-01-17]
procedure: 1. Register {email mới 3} up to page "Xác minh email" (as FE01-INT-01). 2. Check the resend button right away. 3. Wait 60 seconds. 4. Click "Gửi lại email xác minh". 5. Click the link in the first (old) email. 6. Click the link in the second (new) email.
expected_results: 1. Button is disabled with a countdown "thử lại sau {n}s". 2. A second email is received. 3. Old link shows "Liên kết xác minh đã hết hạn hoặc đã được sử dụng." MSG-FE01-06 4. New link opens "Hoàn tất hồ sơ chủ trại".
precondition: 1. {email mới 3} is not registered.

description: Verify that a guest registers with a new Google account. [UC-FE01-01 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Click "Đăng ký bằng Google". 3. Choose Google account {google mới}, grant access. 4. Tick "Tôi đã đọc và đồng ý với Điều khoản sử dụng và Chính sách dữ liệu của BeefCare.". 5. Click "Đồng ý và xác nhận". 6. Enter Số điện thoại liên hệ = "0912345678". 7. Click "Hoàn tất và đăng ký trang trại".
expected_results: 1. Dialog "Điều khoản và chính sách" opens after Google sign-in. 2. Profile screen shows "{google mới} · đã xác minh qua Google". 3. Farm registration screen opens; no verification email is sent.
precondition: 1. Google test account {google mới} never used on BeefCare.

description: Verify that cancelling Google consent creates no account. [UC-FE01-01 exception flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng ký". 2. Click "Đăng ký bằng Google". 3. Choose {google mới 2}. 4. Click "Hủy" on the consent screen.
expected_results: 1. Sign-in page shows "Không thể đăng nhập với Google. Vui lòng thử lại hoặc dùng email." MSG-FE01-12 2. No session; no account is created.
precondition: 1. Google test account {google mới 2} never used on BeefCare.

description: Verify that Owner signs in with email and password. [UC-FE01-02 main flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Enter Email = "owner@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = <correct password>. 3. Click "Đăng nhập". 4. Click the user name at top right.
expected_results: 1. Farm home opens ("Chọn trại" if several farms). 2. Menu has "Hồ sơ của tôi" and "Đăng xuất".
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test is ACTIVE with an ACTIVE farm.

description: Verify that CS and PM land on their own home screens. [UC-FE01-02 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Enter Email = "cs@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = <correct password>. 3. Click "Đăng nhập". 4. Click the user name, click "Đăng xuất". 5. Login as PM (pm@beefcare.test).
expected_results: 1. CS home (customer support area) opens; no "Chọn trại". 2. PM home (platform area) opens and differs from CS.
precondition: 1. cs@beefcare.test and pm@beefcare.test are ACTIVE.

description: Verify that a wrong password shows a generic error. [UC-FE01-02 exception flow; TC-01-24]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Enter Email = "owner@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = "SaiMatKhau@123". 3. Click "Đăng nhập". 4. Click "Thử đăng nhập lại". 5. Enter Email = "khongtontai@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = "SaiMatKhau@123". 6. Click "Đăng nhập".
expected_results: 1. Toast/inline MSG-FE01-01 "Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa chính xác." 2. Unknown email shows the same message.
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test is ACTIVE.

description: Verify that sign-in with empty fields shows required errors. [UC-FE01-02 exception flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Leave Email and Mật khẩu empty. 3. Click "Đăng nhập". 4. Enter Email = "abc@". 5. Click "Đăng nhập".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 under each empty field ("Vui lòng nhập email.", "Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu."). 2. MSG-COM-10 "Email không hợp lệ."; no sign-in request is sent.
precondition: 1. No account is signed in.

description: Verify that 5 wrong passwords lock password sign-in for 15 minutes. [UC-FE01-02 exception flow; TC-01-21]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Enter Email = "{email mới 1}", Mật khẩu = "SaiMatKhau@123". 3. Click "Đăng nhập" 5 times. 4. Enter the correct password. 5. Click "Đăng nhập".
expected_results: 1. Attempts 1-4: MSG-FE01-01 "Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa chính xác." 2. From attempt 5/6: MSG-FE01-02 "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu đang bị khóa sau 5 lần sai…", even with the correct password.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-01 was run; use {email mới 1}, not owner@beefcare.test.

description: Verify that sign-in is refused for an unverified email. [UC-FE01-02 exception flow; TC-01-13]
procedure: 1. Register {email mới 4} up to "Xác minh email" (as FE01-INT-01); do not click the link. 2. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 3. Enter Email = "{email mới 4}", Mật khẩu = <correct password>. 4. Click "Đăng nhập". 5. Click "Gửi lại email xác minh".
expected_results: 1. MSG-FE01-11 "Email chưa được xác minh. Vui lòng mở email xác minh hoặc gửi lại liên kết." 2. Page "Xác minh email" opens with {email mới 4}.
precondition: 1. {email mới 4} is not registered.

description: Verify that a suspended account cannot sign in. [UC-FE01-02 exception flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Enter Email = "suspended@beefcare.test", Mật khẩu = <correct password>. 3. Click "Đăng nhập". 4. Click "Quay lại đăng nhập".
expected_results: 1. Page "Tài khoản đang tạm ngưng" shows "Tài khoản: suspended@beefcare.test". MSG-FE01-03 2. No session; back on sign-in page.
precondition: 1. suspended@beefcare.test was suspended by SA.

description: Verify that a user signs in with an existing Google account. [UC-FE01-02 alternative flow; TC-01-22]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Click "Tiếp tục với Google". 3. Choose {google mới}.
expected_results: 1. Sign-in succeeds; destination follows the profile state. 2. No second account is created.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-07 was run.

description: Verify that Owner signs out and cannot reopen protected pages. [UC-FE01-03 main flow]
procedure: 1. Login as Owner. 2. Open "Đàn bò"; note the address. 3. Click the user name, click "Đăng xuất". 4. Paste the noted address. 5. Click browser Back.
expected_results: 1. Sign-in page opens. 2. Pasted address redirects to sign-in; Back shows no farm data.
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test has an ACTIVE farm.

description: Verify that CS signs out from the same user menu. [UC-FE01-03 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. Login as CS. 2. Click the user name. 3. Click "Đăng xuất". 4. Open the CS area address directly.
expected_results: 1. Menu has "Hồ sơ của tôi" and "Đăng xuất". 2. Sign-in page opens; CS address redirects to sign-in.
precondition: 1. cs@beefcare.test is ACTIVE.

description: Verify that a user edits name and phone in the profile. [UC-FE01-04 main flow; TC-01-08]
procedure: 1. Login as test Owner (not owner@beefcare.test). 2. Click the user name, click "Hồ sơ của tôi". 3. Enter Họ và tên = "Trần Văn Kiểm Thử", Điện thoại liên hệ = "0912345678". 4. Click "Lưu thay đổi". 5. Press F5, open "Hồ sơ của tôi" again.
expected_results: 1. Popup "Cài đặt" shows email with "Email đã xác minh"; email is not editable. 2. MSG-FE01-13 "Hồ sơ của bạn đã được cập nhật." 3. New values persist; menu name and avatar updated.
precondition: 1. Test Owner has no phone number yet.

description: Verify that saving an empty name is rejected. [UC-FE01-04 exception flow; TC-01-02]
procedure: 1. Login as test Owner. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi". 3. Clear Họ và tên. 4. Click "Lưu thay đổi".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 "Họ và tên là bắt buộc." 2. Reload shows the old name.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-19 was run.

description: Verify that an invalid phone number is rejected. [UC-FE01-04 exception flow; TC-01-08]
procedure: 1. Login as test Owner. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi". 3. Enter Điện thoại liên hệ = "12345". 4. Click "Lưu thay đổi". 5. Enter Điện thoại liên hệ = "+84912345678". 6. Click "Lưu thay đổi".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-10 "Số điện thoại không hợp lệ."; not saved. 2. MSG-FE01-13 "Hồ sơ của bạn đã được cập nhật."
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-19 was run.

description: Verify that a user views the read-only role permission table. [UC-FE01-04 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. Login as Owner. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi". 3. Click "Quyền theo vai trò". 4. Select "Chủ trại", "Quản lý", "Kỹ thuật viên" in turn.
expected_results: 1. Address bar does not change. 2. Each role shows a description and a read-only table; no edit button.
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test is ACTIVE.

description: Verify that a user resets the password with the emailed link. [UC-FE01-05 main flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Đăng nhập". 2. Click "Quên mật khẩu?". 3. Enter Email đăng ký = "{email mới 1}". 4. Click "Gửi liên kết đặt lại". 5. Open the reset email, click the link. 6. Enter Mật khẩu mới = Nhập lại mật khẩu = <new valid password>. 7. Click "Lưu mật khẩu mới". 8. Sign in with the old password, then the new one.
expected_results: 1. Page "Kiểm tra email" shows {email mới 1}; one email received. MSG-FE01-05 2. Sign-in page shows "Mật khẩu đã được cập nhật. Bạn có thể đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới." MSG-FE01-07 3. Old password: MSG-FE01-01; new password signs in.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-01 was run; {email mới 1} is not locked.

description: Verify that an unknown email gets the same confirmation page. [UC-FE01-05 exception flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Quên mật khẩu". 2. Enter Email đăng ký = "khongtontai.01@beefcare.test". 3. Click "Gửi liên kết đặt lại".
expected_results: 1. Page "Kiểm tra email" appears as for a real email. MSG-FE01-05 2. No email is sent.
precondition: 1. Email khongtontai.01@beefcare.test is not registered.

description: Verify that empty or invalid email is rejected on forgot password. [UC-FE01-05 exception flow]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Quên mật khẩu". 2. Leave Email đăng ký empty. 3. Click "Gửi liên kết đặt lại". 4. Enter Email đăng ký = "abc@". 5. Click "Gửi liên kết đặt lại".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 "Vui lòng nhập email." 2. MSG-COM-10 "Email không hợp lệ."; "Kiểm tra email" never opens.
precondition: 1. No account is signed in.

description: Verify that a used reset link is rejected. [UC-FE01-05 exception flow; TC-01-15]
procedure: 1. Open the reset link used in FE01-INT-23 again. 2. Click "Yêu cầu liên kết mới".
expected_results: 1. Page shows "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu đã hết hạn hoặc đã được sử dụng." MSG-FE01-06 2. "Quên mật khẩu" page opens.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-23 was run.

description: Verify that an invalid new password is rejected on reset. [UC-FE01-05 exception flow; TC-01-04, TC-01-05, TC-01-06]
procedure: 1. Request a new reset link for {email mới 1}, open it. 2. Enter Mật khẩu mới = Nhập lại mật khẩu = "1234567". 3. Click "Lưu mật khẩu mới". 4. Enter both fields = "{email mới 1}". 5. Click "Lưu mật khẩu mới". 6. Enter two different valid passwords. 7. Click "Lưu mật khẩu mới". 8. Leave both fields empty. 9. Click "Lưu mật khẩu mới".
expected_results: 1. MSG-FE01-08 "Mật khẩu cần từ 8 đến 128 ký tự." / "Mật khẩu không được trùng với email." 2. MSG-FE01-09 "Mật khẩu xác nhận chưa khớp." 3. MSG-COM-06 "Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu mới."; password is unchanged.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-23 was run.

description: Verify that resending the reset link invalidates the old link. [UC-FE01-05 alternative flow; TC-01-17]
procedure: 1. As a guest, go to page "Quên mật khẩu". 2. Enter Email đăng ký = "{email mới 1}". 3. Click "Gửi liên kết đặt lại". 4. Wait 60 seconds. 5. Click "Gửi lại liên kết". 6. Click the link in the first email. 7. Click the link in the second email.
expected_results: 1. Resend button is disabled with a countdown; second email is received. 2. First link: MSG-FE01-06 "Liên kết không còn hiệu lực". 3. Second link opens "Đặt mật khẩu mới".
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-23 was run.

description: Verify that changing the password signs out other sessions. [UC-FE01-06 main flow]
procedure: 1. Login as {chủ trại test} in browser A and incognito browser B. 2. In A: click the user name, "Hồ sơ của tôi". 3. Click "Đổi mật khẩu" in "Bảo mật". 4. Enter Mật khẩu hiện tại = <correct password>, Mật khẩu mới = Nhập lại mật khẩu mới = <new valid password>. 5. Click "Đổi mật khẩu". 6. Reload B. 7. Sign out in A; sign in with old, then new password.
expected_results: 1. Popup closes; MSG-FE01-07 "Mật khẩu đã được đổi. Các phiên khác đã được đăng xuất."; A stays signed in. 2. B redirects to sign-in; notice email received. 3. Old password: MSG-FE01-01; new password signs in.
precondition: 1. {chủ trại test} has a password and is not locked.

description: Verify that a wrong current password is rejected. [UC-FE01-06 exception flow]
procedure: 1. Login as {chủ trại test}. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi", click "Đổi mật khẩu". 3. Enter Mật khẩu hiện tại = "SaiMatKhau@123", new password = <valid password> (both fields). 4. Click "Đổi mật khẩu".
expected_results: 1. MSG-FE01-16 "Mật khẩu hiện tại không đúng."; popup stays open. 2. Password is unchanged.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-29 was run.

description: Verify that empty fields and invalid new password are rejected. [UC-FE01-06 exception flow]
procedure: 1. Login as {chủ trại test}. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi", click "Đổi mật khẩu". 3. Leave all fields empty. 4. Click "Đổi mật khẩu". 5. Enter correct current password, Mật khẩu mới = "1234567", Nhập lại mật khẩu mới = "12345678". 6. Click "Đổi mật khẩu".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 under each empty field ("Mật khẩu hiện tại là bắt buộc." …). 2. MSG-FE01-08 and MSG-FE01-09; password is unchanged.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-29 was run.

description: Verify that a Google-only user adds a first password. [UC-FE01-06 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. Sign in with Google as {google mới}. 2. Open "Hồ sơ của tôi", click "Thêm mật khẩu". 3. Click "Xác minh bằng Google", choose {google mới}. 4. Enter Mật khẩu mới = Nhập lại mật khẩu mới = <valid 12-char password>. 5. Click "Thêm mật khẩu". 6. Sign out, sign in with email {google mới} and the new password.
expected_results: 1. Popup says "Tài khoản này chưa có mật khẩu…"; "Thêm mật khẩu" is disabled before verification. 2. After verification: "Đã xác minh bằng Google. Bạn có thể thêm mật khẩu BeefCare." 3. MSG-FE01-07 shown; email-password sign-in succeeds.
precondition: 1. FE01-INT-07 was run; {google mới} has no password.

description: Verify that Owner submits a valid support ticket. [UC-FE20-01 main flow]
procedure: 1. Login as Owner. 2. Open menu "Hỗ trợ". 3. Click "Gửi yêu cầu mới". 4. Select Danh mục = "Thanh toán". 5. Enter Tiêu đề = "Giao dịch chuyển khoản chưa khớp", Mô tả = "Đã chuyển khoản ngày 15/11". 6. Click "Gửi yêu cầu". 7. Click "Xem yêu cầu".
expected_results: 1. Dialog MSG-FE20-01 "Đã gửi yêu cầu TK-…". 2. Detail page shows status "Mới nhận" and the description in "Trao đổi". 3. "Yêu cầu của tôi" lists TK-… "Mới nhận".
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test is ACTIVE.

description: Verify that Owner cannot submit an empty form. [UC-FE20-01 alternative flow]
procedure: 1. Login as Owner. 2. Click "Gửi yêu cầu mới". 3. Leave Danh mục, Tiêu đề, Mô tả empty. 4. Click "Gửi yêu cầu".
expected_results: 1. MSG-COM-06 under each empty field ("Vui lòng chọn danh mục." / "Vui lòng nhập tiêu đề." / "Vui lòng nhập mô tả."). 2. No ticket is created.
precondition: 1. Owner account owner@beefcare.test is ACTIVE.

description: Verify that Owner cannot use a title over 150 characters. [UC-FE20-01 alternative flow]

description: Save and reopen a private draft
procedure: 1. As Owner, open Thông báo trại and create “QA – Water tank maintenance”. Set the body to “Inspect the valve at 08:00” and save as draft. 2. Refresh the list, reopen the draft, update 08:00 to 09:00, save and refresh again. 3. As the selected Technician in a separate session, search their received announcements.
expected_results: 1. The author sees the same draft with the revised body and “Bản nháp” state. Saving shows “Đã lưu bản nháp thông báo.” (MSG-FE07-01). 2. The recipient has no delivery or published entry for this draft.
precondition: Farm A is active. Owner and Technician accounts have active memberships. Use a unique test title.

description: Validate role-based draft audience
procedure: 1. As Manager, create a draft, choose named recipients and open the selector. 2. Search for an active Technician, an Owner, another Manager and a Technician from Farm B. 3. Select the eligible Technician and save the draft.
expected_results: 1. Only eligible active Technicians of Farm A can be selected by the Manager. The saved audience contains only the chosen Technician.
precondition: Have distinct users for each role and a second farm. Use a Manager account with announcement rights.

description: Correct a published announcement without rewriting history
procedure: 1. As the original author, open a published notice whose v1 said “08:00”. Choose Đính chính, change the text to “09:00”, supply the correction reason and submit. 2. Reload the notice and inspect both versions. In the recipient session, look for the new delivery.
expected_results: 1. The toast reads “Đã đăng phiên bản 2 của thông báo.” (MSG-FE07-04). The saved v1 still says “08:00”. 2. The intended recipient receives the v2 text in a separate version-specific delivery.
precondition: A published notice and a working announcement delivery worker are available. Use the same active recipient for v1 and v2.

description: Protect editing by a different author
procedure: 1. Publish a notice as the Owner. Open the same published notice as an unrelated same-farm Manager, with a separate session, and inspect the available actions. 2. If a previously saved editing link is available, reopen it as that Manager.
expected_results: 1. A non-author cannot update or correct the notice. The published version and recipient delivery remain unchanged.
precondition: Owner is the original author. Non-author Manager has valid access to the farm.

description: Preview and publish a named-recipient announcement
procedure: 1. Open a valid draft as its author, select only Technician A1, open Xem lại & đăng and check the audience count. Confirm publish once. 2. Reload the author list. Sign in separately as A1 and as an eligible but unselected Technician A2.
expected_results: 1. The preview shows one recipient, and the toast reads “Đã đăng thông báo tới 1 người nhận.” (MSG-FE07-03). A1 receives one visible delivery and the author sees the published record. A2 receives none.
precondition: Two active Technicians are available in Farm A. The announcement worker is enabled.

description: Block publication when the named audience is no longer eligible
procedure: 1. Open “Xem lại & đăng” on a draft addressed only to Technician A1. 2. In another authorized Owner session, deactivate A1’s Farm A membership. 3. Return to the still-open preview and click “Đăng thông báo”. 4. Reload “Thông báo trại”, then log in as A1 after the membership is restored to inspect the inbox.
expected_results: 1. The publish flow reports that no eligible recipient is available (MSG-FE07-05). 2. The announcement stays a draft. A1 has no delivery for it.
precondition: The author and A1 are active at the start. Use an isolated farm membership that can be restored.

description: Handle a stale publish preview without duplicating delivery
procedure: 1. As the author, open “Xem lại & đăng” for the same draft from two tabs. 2. In the first tab click “Đăng thông báo” and verify the success message. 3. Click “Đăng thông báo” in the second preview, then refresh “Thông báo trại” and inspect the recipient inbox in a separate session.
expected_results: 1. The second submission is rejected as stale (MSG-COM-05). 2. The author sees one publication and the recipient sees one delivery.
precondition: A saved valid draft and one active named recipient. Both tabs open the preview before either submission.

description: Open the exact delivered version from each notification
procedure: 1. As the selected Technician, open the older and newer delivery rows individually in Thông báo trại. 2. Compare the version numbers and the “08:00” and “09:00” bodies. Refresh each detail.
expected_results: 1. Each delivery opens its own persisted version. The older entry still shows the original body after v2 is published; opening the older link leaves the newer delivery unread until its own link is opened.
precondition: A notice has v1 and v2 delivered to the same Technician; use separate sessions for author and recipient.

description: Restrict announcements by recipient and farm
procedure: 1. Open the selected recipient’s delivered version and copy the detail URL. 2. In separate sessions use the announcement list and that URL as an unselected member of Farm A and a member of Farm B.
expected_results: 1. Neither session sees the delivery or any announcement text in the copied detail. The selected recipient retains normal access.
precondition: The published notice targets one named member of Farm A. Keep separate signed-in sessions.

description: Follow a delivered link when the active list does not show the notice
procedure: 1. As a recipient, copy the link to an announcement already read. Filter Thông báo trại to unread only. Open the saved link in the same authenticated session.
expected_results: 1. The detail opens the exact accessible published version even though the current results did not contain it.
precondition: A farm Manager has permission to read one previously opened announcement and has saved its detail link.

description: Group and filter active reminders, then open the source
procedure: 1. As Owner, open Nhắc việc. Compare overdue, today and upcoming tasks in Farm A’s local time. 2. Filter to a seeded reminder category; open one row and follow the source link. Clear the filter.
expected_results: 1. Active reminders land in the correct time groups. Filtering limits the rows; the selected detail links to the matching record in Farm A.
precondition: Seed active reminders with due dates yesterday, today and within the next seven days. A valid source record exists.

description: Show missing basis and respect Technician read-only scope
procedure: 1. As Technician, open /kt/nhac-viec. Open one reminder permitted to the Technician whose source lacks a required date or basis. 2. Check the detail actions and compare against an Owner session for the same farm.
expected_results: 1. The missing-basis reminder explains what is missing (MSG-FE14-01). Technician can read permitted details without a mutation action or exposure of restricted target records.
precondition: Use a reminder with missing basis and role-specific source access; use active Farm A members.

description: Create and clear a low-stock reminder after replenishment
procedure: 1. As Manager, open Nhắc việc and find REM-10 for a feed item at 0 kg with a minimum of 50 kg. 2. Post a valid 60 kg receipt as Owner. After reconciliation, refresh Nhắc việc and compare the linked inventory.
expected_results: 1. The active REM-10 links to the correct item before replenishment. After posting and reconciliation, stock is 60 kg and this warning is absent from the active list.
precondition: Known opening inventory 0 kg and min stock 50 kg, active supplier and JOB-01 enabled.

description: Resolve a missed feeding reminder after the session is recorded
procedure: 1. Leave the scheduled 06:30 session unrecorded beyond the reminder window. Open its active reminder as Owner and follow the source. 2. Record a valid session in the feeding log, wait for reconciliation and reload reminders and the log.
expected_results: 1. One REM-11 identifies the correct pen/date/session before saving. After saving, the active reminder for that session is cleared and the log shows the saved session.
precondition: Use an active ration and enough stock on the test day, with the local time past 08:30; JOB-01 enabled.

description: Read a subscription or payment notice and reopen the source
procedure: 1. Trigger or prepare a successful local subscription payment event. As the Owner of that farm, open Thông báo của tôi, open its unread notification and follow the target. 2. Reload and compare its state and the notifications shown to a different Owner.
expected_results: 1. The intended Owner opens the matching payment details and sees persisted read state; a different Owner sees no such notice.
precondition: An isolated local payment fixture is confirmed and the notification worker is ready.

description: Open support notifications and mark the category read
procedure: 1. As the CS or PM/SA recipient of an assigned support request, open Thông báo hỗ trợ and follow the unread notice to its assigned ticket or request. 2. Return, use the all-read action and reload the category. Compare with a session signed in as a different platform user.
expected_results: 1. The link opens the intended assigned record; only eligible recipients see it. Mark-all read persists for the recipient (MSG-FE14-02).
precondition: A supported ticket or internal request is assigned and two unread support notices exist for the recipient.

description: Open the PM reconciliation queue from an exception notice
procedure: 1. As PM, open Thông báo đối soát and open an unread reconciliation exception. 2. Check the target payment and reload the notification. Try the same notice link under an account without reconciliation access.
expected_results: 1. PM sees the correct exception and persisted read state. The unauthorized account cannot see the notice or restricted payment details.
precondition: A reconciliation exception with a valid target exists. Use a PM and a separate non-PM account.

description: Load dashboard indicators and follow a drill-down
procedure: 1. As Owner, open Tổng quan. Compare the herd total with a known three-animal Farm A fixture and inspect one non-empty attention item. 2. Use its drill-down action and inspect the target record or filtered list.
expected_results: 1. The dashboard shows the known herd count and the correct farm context. The drill-down opens the correct eligible target.
precondition: Farm A contains three current cattle and one seeded source for an attention item.

description: Switch farm without reusing the previous farm’s counts
procedure: 1. Open Tổng quan in Farm A, then switch to Farm B without reloading the page. 2. Compare values and displayed farm name; switch back to Farm A.
expected_results: 1. Counts and links follow the selected farm. An empty Farm B displays the appropriate zero/empty state without retaining Farm A rows.
precondition: The same user has rights to Farm A with data and a Farm B fixture without cattle.

description: Reject dashboard access for a Technician
procedure: 1. As Owner, confirm /tong-quan shows Farm A indicators. Open the same URL in a separate Technician session, then navigate back to the Technician landing screen.
expected_results: 1. The Technician never sees the management dashboard or Farm A’s management metrics. Their permitted landing and read-only tools remain available.
precondition: Owner and Technician accounts are active in the same farm.

description: Report herd totals and explain a zero result (RPT-01)
procedure: 1. Open “Báo cáo quản lý”, choose “Tổng hợp đàn”, enter the fixture dates and click “Xem báo cáo”. 2. Compare the ending herd and movement totals with the fixture manifest. 3. Repeat for an empty farm or a filter with no matching cattle.
expected_results: 1. The first report shows 3 cattle at period end, 1 herd entry and 0 exits. 2. The empty scope shows 0 and explains why the selected scope has no matching cattle. The result has no animal rows.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. Use a fixture with 3 ending cattle, one intake and no exit during the period. Prepare a separate empty scope.

description: Calculate growth with only eligible weights (RPT-02)
procedure: 1. Choose Hiệu quả tăng trưởng and run for Pen A for a 10-day fixture window. 2. Compare weigh-in counts and average daily gain with the recorded values.
expected_results: 1. Two valid weights 200 kg and 220 kg ten days apart yield 2 kg/day for the qualifying animal. A voided weight is excluded.
precondition: One current cattle record in Pen A, two eligible weights and one voided weight. Use a period containing both valid dates.

description: Reconcile planned, completed and overdue vaccinations (RPT-03)
procedure: 1. Open “Báo cáo quản lý” and choose “Tuân thủ tiêm phòng”. 2. Enter a period containing the fixture for two doses and click “Xem báo cáo”. 3. Read the completed and overdue figures and the vaccine breakdown.
expected_results: 1. One dose is counted as completed and one pending dose is overdue. The completed vaccination appears under the fixture vaccine.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager in the test farm. Prepare one completed on-farm dose and one planned dose whose due date has already passed, both in the chosen period.

description: Reconcile treatment and end-date withdrawal (RPT-04)
procedure: 1. Select Sức khỏe & điều trị. Run the same filters for two end dates, one during a meat withdrawal and one after it ends. Compare cases, treatment breakdown and withdrawal counts.
expected_results: 1. Treatment is attributed to the proper medication; the animal appears in the withdrawal count only for the qualifying as-of date.
precondition: A persisted health case and a treatment with known meat-withdrawal dates; no other qualifying withdrawals.

description: Filter the reproduction report by pen (RPT-05)
procedure: 1. Choose Sinh sản in the fixture period and run with no pen filter. Note the tracked female total. 2. Repeat with QA-A and QA-B individually and check the reported states.
expected_results: 1. The unfiltered total is 2; QA-A shows one AWAITING_BREEDING female and QA-B one IN_ESTRUS female in the prepared snapshot.
precondition: Use the two-pen reproduction fixture with one tracked female per pen; fix the period to include the fixture dates.

description: Limit herd movements to the period (RPT-06)
procedure: 1. Select Biến động đàn. Run a period with one recorded intake, one sale and one pen transfer, plus one movement on the next day. 2. Inspect source/type/pen breakdowns.
expected_results: 1. The three in-period events appear in the correct groups. The event outside the period is excluded.
precondition: Movement records have known effective dates and belong to the selected farm.

description: Distinguish insufficient fattening data from a zero value (RPT-07)
procedure: 1. Select Hiệu quả vỗ béo and run for a pen containing a qualifying animal with start/end weights and an animal missing one required weight. 2. Check the gain, sample and insufficient-data messages.
expected_results: 1. Only qualified cattle contribute to gain. The missing-data count is explicit (MSG-FE15-01); missing weight is not rendered as measured zero.
precondition: Prepare two FATTENING cattle in the same pen. Only one has the required weight history.

description: Print every report type from its applied result
procedure: 1. For each RPT-01 through RPT-07, set its fixture period and run the report. Use In / xuất and save PDF or open print preview. 2. Compare report title, dates, applied filters, results and document margins before closing preview.
expected_results: 1. Each of the seven printouts corresponds to the active result, has meaningful report content, and fits the page without cut columns or an extra blank sheet.
precondition: Backend results exist for all seven report types. Use a browser with PDF preview and retain one PDF per type.

description: Reject a reversed management report period
procedure: 1. Choose Tổng hợp đàn. Enter start date one day later than the end date and try to view it. 2. Correct the dates and resubmit.
expected_results: 1. The invalid range is blocked with a clear period validation message (MSG-COM-11 in spec); correcting the range returns the applicable report.
precondition: Active Farm A and an Owner/Manager user.

description: Reconcile actual cash inflows and outflows with source documents
procedure: 1. As Owner, open Báo cáo thu chi for a fixture period. Compare cash totals against a 3,000,000 VND herd receipt, two recorded herd payments of 1,000,000 and 400,000 VND and one supplier payment of 300,000 VND. 2. Open each document link and check that unpaid or voided payment fixtures are omitted.
expected_results: 1. The report shows four eligible payments by payment date, with 3,000,000 VND in, 1,700,000 VND out and 1,300,000 VND net. Each line opens its original document.
precondition: Use a farm/period without subscriptions or other eligible payments. Add an unpaid payable and a voided payment as exclusions.

description: Exclude subscription payments for Managers
procedure: 1. For a paid subscription posted at 17:30 UTC on calendar day D, run the report for D+1 in Vietnam time as Owner, then as Manager for the same farm. 2. Check source chooser, totals and navigation; try the subscription source in the Manager session.
expected_results: 1. The Owner sees exactly one subscription expense on D+1. The Manager cannot select/view that source and its amount is excluded from the Manager’s totals.
precondition: The same farm has an active Owner and Manager and a paid subscription with one bank receipt; no other entries in the comparison window.

description: Apply cash filters and keep totals across pages
procedure: 1. Run Báo cáo thu chi for a period containing at least 21 qualifying expenses. Filter to Chi and one expense source, advance to page two, then choose a period with no qualifying entries. 2. Try an inverted date range and verify the selected farm after switching context.
expected_results: 1. Filtered records span pages without repeats; totals remain the full filtered amount. The empty period renders an empty state. Invalid dates are blocked; a new farm does not show the previous farm’s data.
precondition: Prepare at least 21 recorded payments under one permitted source, and a second farm and an empty period.

description: Reconcile stock balance and movement history
procedure: 1. Open the Tồn kho tab, find the test feed and open Thẻ kho. Filter to the day of a 100 kg receipt and 20 kg usage. 2. Reload and compare the closing balance and links to the source movements.
expected_results: 1. The item shows 80 kg when starting at zero. The card shows +100 and −20 kg with their correct dates and sources.
precondition: A dedicated feed item has one posted receipt and one saved feeding record with those quantities.

description: Show minimum-stock warning and start a receipt
procedure: 1. Open Tồn kho for a feed that has exactly 50 kg and a threshold of 50 kg. Compare with another feed that has 51 kg at the same threshold. 2. Use the low-stock warning’s receipt action.
expected_results: 1. The 50 kg item is flagged (MSG-FE23-19); the 51 kg item is not. The action opens the new receipt workflow for the selected farm.
precondition: Two active feed items with balances of 50 and 51 kg and a 50 kg threshold.

description: Show an empty stock-card period and recover when the filter is cleared
procedure: 1. Open Thẻ kho for a feed item with a recorded receipt. Select the movement date and confirm it appears. Change the filter to the following day with no movements, then clear the filter.
expected_results: 1. The empty period shows no movements. Clearing the filter brings back the correct receipt; current item balance does not change.
precondition: One active feed item has a known receipt date and no movement on the next day.

description: Save a receipt draft without changing stock
procedure: 1. Open “Phiếu nhập” and create a receipt dated D. 2. Select the supplier and feed. Enter 100 kg at 12,000 VND/kg, a unique reference and expiry D+7. 3. Click “Lưu nháp phiếu”. 4. Refresh the list, reopen the draft and inspect “Tồn kho” and the stock card.
expected_results: 1. The receipt list shows “[code] đã lưu nháp. Tồn kho chưa thay đổi.” (MSG-FE23-02). 2. The exact draft values reload. No receipt movement has been added and stock stays at 100 kg.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. The supplier and feed are active, opening stock is 100 kg and the reference is unused.

description: Post a receipt and update inventory and the supplier balance
procedure: 1. Open a valid 100 kg receipt draft at 12,000 VND/kg in “Phiếu nhập”. 2. Click “Lưu & cộng kho” and wait for the receipt to reopen. 3. Refresh “Tồn kho” and open “Thẻ kho” for the same item. 4. Return to the receipt and inspect the unpaid amount.
expected_results: 1. The receipt is posted and the stock card has one +100 kg receipt movement (MSG-FE23-01). 2. Stock rises to 200 kg and average cost is 11,000 VND/kg. The unpaid amount is 1,200,000 VND.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. Before the test stock is 100 kg at 10,000 VND/kg. The draft has no fee, prepayment or earlier movement.

description: Record a valid supplier payment and verify outstanding debt
procedure: 1. Open a posted receipt with 1,200,000 VND outstanding. 2. Click “Ghi trả nhà cung cấp”. Enter 400,000 VND for today, select “Tiền mặt” and confirm. 3. Reload the receipt and inspect the payment history and “Còn nợ”.
expected_results: 1. Exactly one 400,000 VND payment is visible after reload and the outstanding amount falls to 800,000 VND.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. Use a posted 1,200,000 VND receipt with no prior payment.

description: Reject a receipt with expiry on the intake date
procedure: 1. Open “Phiếu nhập” and create a new receipt dated D. 2. Select an active supplier and feed. Enter 10 kg at 12,000 VND/kg, and set “Hạn sử dụng” to D. 3. Click “Lưu & cộng kho”. 4. Reopen “Phiếu nhập” and “Tồn kho” to verify the starting state.
expected_results: 1. The line shows “Hạn dùng phải sau ngày nhập.” (MSG-FE23-03). 2. No matching posted receipt or stock movement exists.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. An active supplier and feed item exist. D is today in farm time.

description: Block a supplier payment above the outstanding balance
procedure: 1. Open a posted receipt with 120,000 VND outstanding. 2. Click “Ghi trả nhà cung cấp”. Enter 120,001 VND, select “Tiền mặt” and attempt to confirm. 3. Refresh the receipt and inspect payment history.
expected_results: 1. The payment is rejected for exceeding the amount due (MSG-FE06-13). 2. No payment is added and the balance stays at 120,000 VND.
precondition: Sign in as Owner or Manager. Use a separate posted receipt with 120,000 VND outstanding and no previous payments.

description: Persist selected and free-text receiver names
procedure: 1. In two new drafts, choose an active farm member from Người nhận hàng in the first and type “QA Receiving Desk” in the second. Save and reopen each. 2. Try entering over 100 characters in a separate draft.
expected_results: 1. The saved names reload verbatim for both selection methods. The receiver name is limited to 100 characters (MSG-COM-10 in spec).
precondition: One selectable farm member and valid supplier, stock item and receipt dates.

description: Adjust quantity by 0.1 and keep the selected unit visible
procedure: 1. Pick a feed with purchase unit bao (25 kg per bag) and kg. Enter 10 bao and use one increment and one decrement. Switch unit to kg and save/reopen the draft.
expected_results: 1. The input changes 10 → 10.1 → 10. The unit is visible in both modes. The conversion is 250 kg for 10 bao and 10 kg for 10 kg; the saved unit and displayed unit price agree.
precondition: One feed with both kg and a configured 25 kg purchase unit.

description: Verify the saved receipt’s print layout
procedure: 1. Open a posted receipt, use its print action and view the PDF preview. Compare receipt code, supplier, receiver, quantities, units, total and payment data; repeat with a long receipt.
expected_results: 1. The document uses persisted values, fits the printable area and repeats the relevant table header on overflow pages.
precondition: One short and one multi-page saved receipt containing multiple receipt lines; PDF preview available.

description: Void a posted receipt when the inventory can absorb the reversal
procedure: 1. Open a posted 100 kg receipt when stock is 130 kg. Choose Hủy phiếu, verify the confirmation and submit a reason. Refresh the receipt and the stock card.
expected_results: 1. The confirmation shows the correct quantity (MSG-FE23-04). The receipt becomes VOIDED (MSG-FE23-06); balance falls to 30 kg with one reversal. Prior payment history remains readable.
precondition: A posted receipt for 100 kg with a recorded payment and 130 kg available stock before void.

description: Block a receipt void when stock is too low
procedure: 1. Open a 100 kg posted receipt whose remaining stock has been reduced to 50 kg. Attempt to void it with a reason. Refresh the receipt and card.
expected_results: 1. The screen gives the insufficient-stock explanation (MSG-FE23-05). The receipt remains posted, balance stays 50 kg and no reversal is added.
precondition: A 100 kg posted receipt and known 50 kg balance for its feed.

description: Cancel the confirmation before reversing a receipt
procedure: 1. Open a posted receipt, click Hủy phiếu and close the confirmation without submitting. Reload the receipt and stock card.
expected_results: 1. The receipt stays posted. Available stock and the movement list are unchanged.
precondition: A posted receipt with sufficient stock to reverse 100 kg.

description: Post a counted shortage and preserve the source receipt
procedure: 1. Create a Kiểm kho document for system stock 200 kg. Enter the counted stock 190 kg and reason “Counting discrepancy”; save draft and compare stock. Reopen, post and open the stock card.
expected_results: 1. Draft leaves stock at 200 kg. Posting gives a −10 kg adjustment (MSG-FE23-07), priced at the captured average cost, and leaves the source receipt unchanged.
precondition: Known 200 kg balance and average cost; source receipt is recorded.

description: Require a reason on a line with a discrepancy
procedure: 1. On a new stock adjustment set counted stock 190 kg when system stock is 200 kg and omit the line reason. Attempt to post and reload the inventory.
expected_results: 1. The row-level reason is required (MSG-FE23-08); no balance change or posted movement occurs.
precondition: Use a fresh item at 200 kg with no pending count by another tester.

description: Post a counted surplus and refresh inventory
procedure: 1. Open Kiểm kho, create a count with stock 200 kg, enter 210 kg counted and give the line reason “Found unopened bag”. Post and reopen the stock card.
expected_results: 1. The adjustment is posted (MSG-FE23-07), one +10 kg movement appears, and stock is 210 kg.
precondition: A feed item has known stock of 200 kg and no concurrent movements.

description: View the correct ration by date and role
procedure: 1. As Manager, open Khẩu phần and check current and scheduled versions, then open hôm nay. As Technician, open the read-only feeding view for the same pen.
expected_results: 1. The ration effective on the selected date is shown with the correct meal quantities. A future version remains scheduled; Technician can view the applicable version without edit actions.
precondition: A pen in Farm A has v1 effective today and v2 starting tomorrow, with different quantities.

description: Print the saved ration version
procedure: 1. Open the detail of a saved ration version, use the print action, then compare its effective dates, pen, feed lines and quantities with the detail.
expected_results: 1. Print preview shows the selected version and saved line values with readable margins and no blank page.
precondition: A saved ration has two sessions and at least two feed lines.

description: Show the no-ration state for an unassigned pen
procedure: 1. As Technician, open /kt/thuc-an. Inspect Pen A with an effective ration and Pen B without one for the same day.
expected_results: 1. Pen A shows its real ration. Pen B shows “Chưa có khẩu phần hiệu lực” and does not show Pen A’s feeding quantities.
precondition: Two visible pens in the same farm; only Pen A has an effective ration.

description: Schedule a new version and preserve earlier dates
procedure: 1. In Khẩu phần, start a new version of the same ration for the pen effective tomorrow, change 5 to 6 kg/head/meal and save. Reload the version list and check today and tomorrow.
expected_results: 1. New version starts tomorrow (MSG-FE23-09). Previous version ends the day before and still supplies 5 kg today; tomorrow supplies 6 kg.
precondition: One current ration for the test pen, no existing conflicting version tomorrow.

description: Reject a ration backdated to today and a competing schedule
procedure: 1. Try saving a new ration from today, then try a different ration for a pen already assigned a scheduled ration on the chosen future date. 2. Inspect the list after both submissions.
expected_results: 1. Today is rejected (MSG-FE23-10). The competing schedule is rejected (MSG-FE23-11) and does not create an overlapping assignment.
precondition: One active pen with a scheduled future assignment from a different ration.

description: Cancel a scheduled ration and stop an effective ration
procedure: 1. Cancel a future ration from its detail and reload the schedule. In a separate fixture, stop an effective ration using an allowed end date and inspect history and later plans.
expected_results: 1. The cancelled version remains in history but never becomes effective. The stopped version keeps its valid historical dates and stops supplying later plans.
precondition: Prepare distinct pens/versions so each action can be observed independently.

description: Read the saved and unrecorded sessions and print the log
procedure: 1. As Technician, open Nhật ký cho ăn for the fixture date and pen. Compare saved and unrecorded sessions. As Manager, print the filtered saved log and inspect its preview.
expected_results: 1. The UI distinguishes recorded and unrecorded sessions; Technician has read-only access. The print document reflects the chosen date/pen and persisted saved data.
precondition: One pen has two scheduled sessions, only one saved. Technician and Manager are active members.

description: Filter the feeding log by date and pen
procedure: 1. As Manager, open Nhật ký cho ăn. Set the date of two saved records and choose Pen A. Switch the pen filter to Pen B and reopen the matching row.
expected_results: 1. Only records belonging to the selected date and pen appear. Each opens the corresponding saved record.
precondition: Two pens have distinct feeding records on the same day and different recorded amounts.

description: Open a day with no recorded feeding
procedure: 1. As Technician, visit Nhật ký cho ăn for a pen/day with scheduled sessions but no saved records. Inspect the session cards and available actions.
expected_results: 1. Sessions are shown as unrecorded. The screen displays no completed feeding for that day and offers the Technician no recording action.
precondition: An effective ration has a morning session. No record exists for that pen/date.

description: Record an actual feeding session from the effective ration
procedure: 1. Open the recording dialog for an earlier session today for a pen of 12 cattle. Check plan 5 kg/head × 12 = 60 kg and enter 54 kg actual, then save and reload the log and stock card.
expected_results: 1. The log shows one record for the session (MSG-FE23-12) with 60 kg planned and 54 kg actual. Stock falls from 100 kg to 46 kg with one movement.
precondition: Effective ration at 5 kg/head for that session, 12 current cattle and 100 kg available.

description: Record actual amounts without an effective ration
procedure: 1. Choose a pen that has no effective ration today. Open Ghi bữa ăn, add 10 kg actual of an active feed and save. Reopen the same session and inspect stock.
expected_results: 1. The dialog shows “Chưa có khẩu phần cho cữ này. Thêm thức ăn thực tế để tiếp tục.” (MSG-FE23-20) and lets the user record actual feed. The session persists without a fabricated plan and stock falls by 10 kg.
precondition: An unrecorded pen/session with no effective ration and at least 10 kg of an active feed.

description: Guard against duplicates and insufficient stock
procedure: 1. As Owner, reopen the recording flow for an already saved morning session or submit from a second dialog opened before the first save. For an unsaved afternoon session with 40 kg in stock, try saving 50 kg.
expected_results: 1. The duplicate points to the existing record or is rejected (MSG-FE23-13). The 50 kg entry is blocked (MSG-FE23-14); neither attempt adds a movement.
precondition: One saved and one unsaved session. The comparison feed has 40 kg stock before invalid submission.

description: Correct actual feeding and check the stock difference
procedure: 1. Open a saved 60 kg usage record and change it to 50 kg with a reason. Reload the record, revision history and stock card. 2. Try editing again to consume more than available stock.
expected_results: 1. The record shows 50 kg and the correction (MSG-FE23-15), returning 10 kg once. The later excessive edit is rejected (MSG-FE23-14).
precondition: A saved 60 kg feeding record with a known balance and access to its card.

description: Void a feeding record and restore inventory
procedure: 1. Open a valid saved 60 kg usage record. Check its void confirmation, enter the required reason and confirm. Reload the log and inventory.
expected_results: 1. The confirmation states the quantity to restore (MSG-FE23-16). The record is VOIDED, stock increases by 60 kg once, and the original use stays in history.
precondition: A separate valid 60 kg feeding record; keep exact opening stock before void.

description: Keep the first correction when a second edit is stale
procedure: 1. Open one feeding record in two Manager sessions. Save a valid quantity correction in the first, then submit the still-open edit from the second. Refresh both and check Thẻ kho.
expected_results: 1. The stale edit is rejected (MSG-COM-05). Only the first quantity and its movement are persisted.
precondition: A correction-eligible feeding record with enough stock and two active Manager sessions.

description: Create feed and supplier and read them in a receipt
procedure: 1. In Danh mục add a test supplier and an active feed with kg stock unit and a 25 kg purchase unit. Open a new receipt and locate both entries after refresh.
expected_results: 1. Both records persist (MSG-FE23-17); the new receipt uses the saved supplier and feed with the purchase unit conversion.
precondition: Use unique supplier name and feed code. Use an active farm and a Manager/Owner.

description: Enforce catalogue restrictions after stock activity
procedure: 1. Open a feed used by a posted receipt and inspect code and stock unit. Deactivate a separate unused feed and open a new receipt.
expected_results: 1. Code and stock unit of the used feed are locked or changes are rejected (MSG-FE23-18). The inactive item is ineligible for new receipts; historical documents remain readable.
precondition: One used feed and one active but unused test feed.

description: Reject a feed form with a missing name
procedure: 1. In Danh mục choose to add a feed. Enter an unused test code and group, keep Tên blank, and try to save. Refresh and search for the code.
expected_results: 1. The name is required (MSG-COM-06) and no feed item exists with the unsaved code.
precondition: Active farm, unused code and a role allowed to manage the feed catalogue.

description: Reconcile usage, average cost and loss in the feed report
procedure: 1. Open Báo cáo under Thức ăn. Run for the fixture period grouped by herd group, then by pen. Compare actual usage, cost, plan variance and separate adjustment loss.
expected_results: 1. With planned 60 kg and actual 54 kg, variance is −10%. At 10,000 VND/kg, usage cost is 540,000 VND. A separate loss adjustment is not counted in the consumed amount.
precondition: Known historical cost snapshot, one eligible feeding record and one posted loss adjustment in the same period.

description: Print the feed report with readable page margins
procedure: 1. In the same tab first preview a management report, then open /thuc-an/bao-cao and run a period with known usage. Print the feed report as PDF with the browser margin set to zero. Inspect the first page and body.
expected_results: 1. The preview is A4 portrait with internal spacing and visible report content. It shows the applied period, totals and tables without flush-to-edge text or blank pages.
precondition: A non-empty feed report result and a browser with PDF preview.

description: Show no consumption for an empty reporting period
procedure: 1. In Báo cáo under Thức ăn enter a period that has neither saved feeding nor posted adjustments. Run the report, then rerun for a known populated period.
expected_results: 1. The empty period shows no consumption detail or invented costs. Switching period displays only the persisted records of the new period.
precondition: Choose an isolated date range without feeding or loss and a second range with one persisted feeding record.

description: Register a farm with valid data and leave plan selection for later
procedure: 1. Open http://localhost:5173/chon-trai and click "Đăng ký trại mới" 2. Enter "Tên trại *": 'Trại Thử IT 01', choose "Tỉnh/Thành *": 'Hà Nội', enter "Xã/Phường *": 'Xã Tản Lĩnh', "Điện thoại liên hệ": '0912345678', choose one "Quy mô dự kiến" and two "Giống chủ lực" 3. Click "Tạo trại và tiếp tục" 4. On the plan page click "Để sau" 5. Sign out, sign in as pm@beefcare.local and open "Dịch vụ trang trại"
expected_results: 1. Toast "Đã đăng ký trại Trại Thử IT 01. Hãy chọn gói để kích hoạt." (MSG-FE02-01) 2. The page "Đăng ký gói dịch vụ · Trại Thử IT 01" opens with "Kỳ dịch vụ: Chưa có" 3. After "Để sau", "Chọn trang trại để tiếp tục" shows a card 'Trại Thử IT 01' with status "Chờ thanh toán", "Vai trò của bạn: Chủ trại", "Chưa có kỳ dịch vụ" and the button "Thanh toán để kích hoạt" 4. On "Dịch vụ trang trại" the farm is listed with "Chờ thanh toán"; the tile "Chờ thanh toán" has grown by 1
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local (Owner registration completed) 2. No farm named 'Trại Thử IT 01' exists 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Register with the required fields left empty
procedure: 1. Open http://localhost:5173/dang-ky-trai 2. Leave "Tên trại *", "Tỉnh/Thành *" and "Xã/Phường *" empty 3. Click "Tạo trại và tiếp tục" 4. Open /chon-trai
expected_results: 1. Under the fields: "Tên trại là bắt buộc.", "Tỉnh/Thành là bắt buộc.", "Xã/Phường là bắt buộc." (MSG-COM-06) 2. The page stays on "Đăng ký trang trại"; no toast 3. The number of farms on "Chọn trang trại để tiếp tục" is unchanged
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Register with a farm name of 1 character
procedure: 1. Open http://localhost:5173/dang-ky-trai 2. Enter "Tên trại *": 'A', choose a province, enter a commune 3. Click "Tạo trại và tiếp tục"
expected_results: 1. "Tên trại cần có từ 2 đến 150 ký tự." is shown under "Tên trại *" (MSG-COM-10) 2. No farm is created
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Register with an invalid contact phone
procedure: 1. Open http://localhost:5173/dang-ky-trai 2. Fill the required fields with valid data and enter "Điện thoại liên hệ": '12345' 3. Click "Tạo trại và tiếp tục"
expected_results: 1. "Nhập số điện thoại Việt Nam hợp lệ." is shown under "Điện thoại liên hệ" (MSG-COM-10) 2. No farm is created
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Register a farm before the Owner profile is completed
procedure: 1. Open http://localhost:5173/dang-ky-trai 2. Fill the required fields with valid data and click "Tạo trại và tiếp tục" 3. Click "Hoàn tất hồ sơ" in the dialog
expected_results: 1. Dialog "Chưa hoàn tất hồ sơ Chủ trại": "Vui lòng hoàn tất hồ sơ Chủ trại trước khi đăng ký trại." (MSG-FE02-02) 2. "Tạo trại và tiếp tục" is disabled; no farm is created 3. The page "Hoàn tất hồ sơ chủ trại" opens

description: Owner enters an ACTIVE farm from the farm list

expected_results: 1. The card shows the commune and province, status "Đang hoạt động", "Vai trò của bạn: Chủ trại", "Quy mô" and "Dịch vụ" 2. The farm home "Tổng quan" opens; the top bar shows 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 3. The left menu has "Thông tin trại", "Thành viên & quyền" and "Gói dịch vụ"

description: Technician enters the farm and lands on the technician home
procedure: 1. Sign in as technician@beefcare.local 2. If the farm list opens, click "Vào trại" on 'BeefCare Local Farm A'
expected_results: 1. The technician home opens with the bottom menu "Trang chủ", "Đàn bò", "Quét QR", "Sinh sản", "Thức ăn", "Tài khoản" 2. Owner pages such as "Thông tin trại" are not in the menu

description: Manager sees a farm that is not ACTIVE as a locked card
procedure: 1. As pm@beefcare.local suspend 'BeefCare Local Farm A' (FE02-INT-21) 2. Sign in as manager@beefcare.local and open http://localhost:5173/chon-trai 3. Try to open the farm from the card
expected_results: 1. The card shows status "Tạm ngưng" and "Chủ trại quản lý gói dịch vụ" 2. The card reads "BeefCare Local Farm A không khả dụng vì dịch vụ đang ở trạng thái Tạm ngưng. Vui lòng liên hệ Chủ trại." (MSG-FE02-04) 3. There is no "Vào trại" button; no farm page opens
precondition: 1. manager@beefcare.local is an ACTIVE Manager of 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Restore the farm after this case (FE02-INT-22) 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner of a farm waiting for payment opens it from the card
procedure: 1. Sign in as owner@beefcare.local and open http://localhost:5173/chon-trai 2. On the card 'Trại Thử IT 01' click "Thanh toán để kích hoạt"
expected_results: 1. The plan page of 'Trại Thử IT 01' opens 2. The banner reads "Trại Thử IT 01 đang ở trạng thái Chờ thanh toán. Chỉ dùng được thông tin trại, gói dịch vụ và hỗ trợ." (MSG-FE02-03)
precondition: 1. 'Trại Thử IT 01' is PENDING_PAYMENT (FE02-INT-01) 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Switch farm from the top bar clears the previous farm's data
procedure: 1. In 'BeefCare Local Farm A' open "Đàn bò" and type a search text 2. Click the farm name in the top bar and choose 'Trại Thử IT 01' 3. Open "Đàn bò" again 4. Open the top-bar switcher and click "Quản lý trang trại"
expected_results: 1. The home of 'Trại Thử IT 01' opens; the switcher marks it "Đang chọn" 2. "Đàn bò" shows only the cattle of 'Trại Thử IT 01' (none) and the search box is empty (R-02-12) 3. "Quản lý trang trại" opens "Chọn trang trại để tiếp tục"
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 2. 'BeefCare Local Farm A' and 'Trại Thử IT 01' are both ACTIVE (run after FE19-INT-07) 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner updates contact and operating information
procedure: 1. In 'BeefCare Local Farm A' open "Thông tin trại" 2. Change "Người liên hệ" to 'Nguyễn Văn IT', "Giờ bắt đầu ca sáng" to '05:30' and "Ghi chú vận hành" to 'Kiểm thử tích hợp' 3. Click "Lưu thay đổi" 4. Reload the page (F5)
expected_results: 1. Toast "Đã cập nhật thông tin trại." (MSG-FE02-05) 2. After reload the three fields keep the new values 3. "Múi giờ" shows "UTC+7 (giờ Việt Nam)"; the service block ("Trạng thái dịch vụ", "Kỳ hiện tại đến", "Còn lại") is read only
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local; 'BeefCare Local Farm A' is the current farm 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Save farm information with an empty farm name
procedure: 1. Open "Thông tin trại" 2. Clear "Tên trại *" 3. Click "Lưu thay đổi" 4. Reload the page
expected_results: 1. "Tên trại là bắt buộc." is shown under "Tên trại *" (MSG-COM-06) 2. No success toast 3. After reload the old farm name is still shown
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Save operating notes longer than 1,000 characters
procedure: 1. Open "Thông tin trại" 2. Paste 1,001 characters into "Ghi chú vận hành" 3. Click "Lưu thay đổi"
expected_results: 1. "Ghi chú vận hành tối đa 1.000 ký tự." is shown (MSG-COM-10) 2. The notes are not saved (reload shows the previous text)
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Save in a second tab after the information was changed in the first tab
procedure: 1. Open "Thông tin trại" in tab 1 and tab 2 2. In tab 1 change "Người liên hệ" and click "Lưu thay đổi" 3. In tab 2 change "Ghi chú vận hành" and click "Lưu thay đổi" 4. Reload tab 2
expected_results: 1. Tab 1 shows "Đã cập nhật thông tin trại." 2. Tab 2 shows "Dữ liệu đã thay đổi ở phiên khác. Tải lại trang rồi thử lại." (MSG-COM-05) 3. After reload tab 2 shows tab 1's change; tab 2's note was not saved
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in 'BeefCare Local Farm A' in two browser tabs 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Manager cannot open the farm information page
procedure: 1. Sign in as manager@beefcare.local and enter 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Look for "Thông tin trại" in the left menu 3. Type http://localhost:5173/thong-tin-trai in the address bar
expected_results: 1. "Thông tin trại" is not in the menu (the Manager menu has "Thành viên & quyền") 2. Opening the URL returns to the Manager home; no farm information is shown (MSG-COM-01, Q8)
precondition: 1. manager@beefcare.local is an ACTIVE Manager of the ACTIVE 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM reviews the service of every farm and filters by a tile
procedure: 1. Sign in as pm@beefcare.local and open "Dịch vụ trang trại" 2. Read the tiles "Tổng số trại", "Đang hoạt động", "Chờ thanh toán", "Hết hạn", "Tạm ngưng" 3. Click the tile "Chờ thanh toán"
expected_results: 1. The tiles count every farm of the platform; "Đang hoạt động" shows the percentage of all farms 2. After the click only farms with "Chờ thanh toán" are listed, 'Trại Thử IT 01' among them 3. Columns "Trang trại", "Chủ trại", "Dịch vụ", "Hết kỳ", "Tạm ngưng", "Quy mô"; no cattle or care data is shown
precondition: 1. Seed farms A, B, C and 'Trại Thử IT 01' exist 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM searches a farm by Owner email
procedure: 1. On "Dịch vụ trang trại" type 'other-owner@beefcare.local' in "Tìm trại" 2. Clear the box and type 'xyz-khong-co'
expected_results: 1. Only 'BeefCare Local Farm B' is listed 2. "Không có trại phù hợp" with "Thử đổi từ khóa hoặc bộ lọc trạng thái." (MSG-COM-04)
precondition: 1. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM opens the subscription of a farm from the service list
procedure: 1. On "Dịch vụ trang trại" click "Xem gói" on 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Read the detail "Gói của BeefCare Local Farm A"
expected_results: 1. "Gói đăng ký" opens with the farm selected 2. The detail shows "Dịch vụ", "Kỳ hiện tại", "Đã xác nhận đến", "Kỳ mua gần nhất", "Gia hạn mở từ" and the table "Kỳ đã mua và thanh toán nguồn" (or "Chưa có kỳ đã mua.")
precondition: 1. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local; Farm A has a PAID period (data preparation P1) 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM filters subscriptions with a reversed end-date range
procedure: 1. Open "Gói đăng ký" 2. Enter "Xác nhận đến từ ngày" 31/12/2027 and "Xác nhận đến ngày" 01/01/2027
expected_results: 1. "Ngày bắt đầu không được sau ngày kết thúc." is shown (MSG-COM-11) 2. The list stays as before; no new search is run
precondition: 1. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: CS and SA cannot open the farm service pages
procedure: 1. Sign in as cs@beefcare.local; look at the left menu; type http://localhost:5173/nen-tang/dich-vu 2. Repeat as sa@beefcare.local
expected_results: 1. "Dịch vụ trang trại" and "Gói đăng ký" are not in the menu 2. The URL does not show the farm service list (redirect to the role's home or MSG-COM-01)
precondition: 1. cs@beefcare.local and sa@beefcare.local exist 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM suspends a farm and members lose access at their next action
procedure: 1. As pm@beefcare.local on "Dịch vụ trang trại" click "Tạm ngưng" on 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Enter "Lý do tạm ngưng *": 'Kiểm thử tích hợp tạm ngưng' 3. Click "Tạm ngưng dịch vụ" 4. As technician@beefcare.local (already in the farm) open "Đàn bò" 5. As owner@beefcare.local open the notification bell
expected_results: 1. The dialog shows "Tạm ngưng dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm A? Thành viên mất quyền thao tác trại; Chủ trại vẫn dùng được gói dịch vụ và hỗ trợ." (MSG-FE02-06) 2. Toast "Dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm A hiện là tạm ngưng. Đã thông báo cho Chủ trại." (MSG-FE02-08); the row shows "Tạm ngưng" and "Có · từ <today>" 3. The Technician is refused (farm service not ACTIVE, MSG-COM-12) 4. The Owner has the notice "Dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm A hiện là Tạm ngưng. Lý do: Kiểm thử tích hợp tạm ngưng"
precondition: 1. 'BeefCare Local Farm A' is ACTIVE with a running paid period (data preparation P1) 2. technician@beefcare.local is signed in to Farm A in another browser profile 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: PM restores a suspended farm
procedure: 1. On "Dịch vụ trang trại" click "Khôi phục" on 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Read "Tạm ngưng từ", "Kỳ dịch vụ đã mua" and "Sau khôi phục" 3. Enter "Lý do khôi phục *": 'Đã xác minh xong' and click "Khôi phục dịch vụ" 4. As technician@beefcare.local open "Đàn bò" again
expected_results: 1. The popup shows the suspension date and PM, the purchased period "(không đổi)" and the status after restore 2. It reads "Khôi phục dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm A? Trạng thái sẽ theo gói dịch vụ: <status>." (MSG-FE02-07) 3. "Sau khôi phục" is "Đang hoạt động"; toast "Dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm A hiện là đang hoạt động. Đã thông báo cho Chủ trại." (MSG-FE02-08) 4. The Technician can use "Đàn bò" again
precondition: 1. 'BeefCare Local Farm A' is SUSPENDED (FE02-INT-21) 2. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Suspend without a reason
procedure: 1. Click "Tạm ngưng" on an ACTIVE farm 2. Leave "Lý do tạm ngưng *" empty and click "Tạm ngưng dịch vụ"
expected_results: 1. "Lý do tạm ngưng là bắt buộc." is shown under the field (MSG-COM-06) 2. The dialog stays open; the farm stays "Đang hoạt động"
precondition: 1. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Suspend a farm that another PM session has already suspended
procedure: 1. Open "Dịch vụ trang trại" in tab 1 and tab 2 2. In tab 1 suspend 'BeefCare Local Farm C' with a reason 3. In tab 2 (not reloaded) click "Tạm ngưng" on the same farm, enter a reason and click "Tạm ngưng dịch vụ"
expected_results: 1. Tab 2 shows "BeefCare Local Farm C đã ở trạng thái Tạm ngưng." (MSG-FE02-09) or "Dữ liệu trại vừa thay đổi ở phiên khác. Đóng hộp thoại, tải lại danh sách rồi thử lại." (MSG-COM-05) 2. After reload only one suspension is recorded (the Owner of Farm C has one notice)
precondition: 1. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local in two tabs; 'BeefCare Local Farm C' is ACTIVE 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Restore a farm that has never been paid
procedure: 1. On "Dịch vụ trang trại" click "Khôi phục" on 'BeefCare Local Farm C' 2. Read "Kỳ dịch vụ đã mua" and "Sau khôi phục" 3. Enter a reason and click "Khôi phục dịch vụ" 4. As owner-2@beefcare.local open /chon-trai
expected_results: 1. "Kỳ dịch vụ đã mua" shows "Chưa có kỳ dịch vụ"; "Sau khôi phục" is "Chờ thanh toán" (AF2: restore never creates a period) 2. Toast "Dịch vụ của BeefCare Local Farm C hiện là chờ thanh toán. Đã thông báo cho Chủ trại." 3. The Owner's card shows "Chờ thanh toán" with "Thanh toán để kích hoạt"
precondition: 1. 'BeefCare Local Farm C' is SUSPENDED by the previous case and has no paid period (seed data) 2. Signed in as pm@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner invites a Technician and the invitation e-mail arrives
procedure: 1. In 'BeefCare Local Farm A' open "Thành viên & quyền" and click "Mời thành viên" 2. Enter "Email người nhận *": 'it-tech01@example.test', choose "Vai trò *": "Kỹ thuật viên", "Hết hạn sau": "7 ngày" 3. Click "Gửi lời mời" 4. Click "Lời mời" and open the tab "Đang chờ" 5. Open Mailpit (http://localhost:8025)
expected_results: 1. Before a role is chosen the dialog shows "Chọn vai trò để xem các quyền cố định." 2. Toast "Đã tạo lời mời tới it-tech01@example.test. Hệ thống đang gửi email. Hết hạn lúc <now + 7 days>." (MSG-FE03-01) 3. "Lời mời thành viên" lists the address with "Kỹ thuật viên", "Đang chờ" and "Chưa có tài khoản" 4. Mailpit has one e-mail "Lời mời tham gia trang trại BeefCare" to that address with the button "Xem lời mời"
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local; 'BeefCare Local Farm A' is ACTIVE 2. No invitation or member uses 'it-tech01@example.test' 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Send an invitation with an empty or invalid e-mail
procedure: 1. Click "Mời thành viên" 2. Leave "Email người nhận *" empty, choose "Quản lý", click "Gửi lời mời" 3. Enter 'abc' and click "Gửi lời mời"
expected_results: 1. "Email người nhận là bắt buộc." under the field (MSG-COM-06) 2. "Nhập địa chỉ email hợp lệ." under the field (MSG-COM-10) 3. No invitation appears on "Lời mời"
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in the ACTIVE 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Send an invitation without choosing a role
procedure: 1. Click "Mời thành viên" 2. Enter 'it-norole@example.test' and do not choose "Vai trò *" 3. Click "Gửi lời mời"
expected_results: 1. No role is preselected 2. "Vai trò là bắt buộc." under "Vai trò *" (MSG-COM-06) 3. No invitation is created
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in the ACTIVE 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Invite an e-mail that already has a pending invitation
procedure: 1. Click "Mời thành viên" 2. Enter 'IT-TECH01@EXAMPLE.TEST' (other letter case), choose "Kỹ thuật viên", click "Gửi lời mời" 3. Click "Gửi lại" in the dialog 4. Open "Lời mời" → "Đang chờ"
expected_results: 1. The dialog shows "Đã có lời mời đang chờ cho email này." with "Gửi lại" (MSG-FE03-03) 2. After "Gửi lại" the toast reads "Đã cập nhật lời mời tới it-tech01@example.test. Hệ thống đang gửi email. Hết hạn lúc …" 3. Still one row for the address on "Đang chờ"
precondition: 1. The PENDING invitation of FE03-INT-01 exists 2. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Invite an e-mail that is already an ACTIVE member
procedure: 1. Click "Mời thành viên" 2. Enter 'technician@beefcare.local', choose "Kỹ thuật viên", click "Gửi lời mời"
expected_results: 1. "Email này đã là thành viên đang hoạt động." is shown (MSG-FE03-02) 2. No invitation is created
precondition: 1. technician@beefcare.local is an ACTIVE member of 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Invite while the farm service is not ACTIVE
procedure: 1. Open "Thành viên & quyền" of 'Trại Thử IT 01' 2. Look at the notice and the button "Mời thành viên"
expected_results: 1. Notice "Dịch vụ trại hiện không hoạt động. Bạn vẫn có thể xem và ngưng thành viên; mời, đổi vai trò và kích hoạt lại cần trại đang hoạt động (ACTIVE)." (MSG-FE03-04) 2. "Mời thành viên" cannot be used; no invitation can be sent
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local; 'Trại Thử IT 01' is PENDING_PAYMENT (FE02-INT-01) 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner resends a pending invitation and only the new link works
procedure: 1. Open "Lời mời" → "Đang chờ" 2. Click "Gửi lại" on 'it-tech01@example.test' 3. In Mailpit open the older invitation e-mail and click "Xem lời mời" 4. Open the newest e-mail and click "Xem lời mời"
expected_results: 1. Toast "Đã cập nhật lời mời tới it-tech01@example.test. Hệ thống đang gửi email. Hết hạn lúc <new expiry>." (MSG-FE03-05); "Gửi lần cuối" is updated 2. Mailpit has one more invitation e-mail 3. The old link shows "Lời mời không còn hiệu lực" 4. The new link shows "Lời mời tham gia trang trại" (sign in as the invited e-mail if asked)
precondition: 1. The PENDING invitation of FE03-INT-01 exists 2. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner cancels a pending invitation
procedure: 1. Invite 'it-cancel@example.test' as "Quản lý" 2. On "Lời mời" click "Hủy" on that row 3. Click "Hủy lời mời" 4. Open the tab "Đã hủy" 5. Open the invitation link from Mailpit
expected_results: 1. Dialog "Hủy lời mời": "Hủy lời mời gửi it-cancel@example.test? Link sẽ không còn tác dụng." (MSG-FE03-06) 2. Toast "Đã hủy lời mời." (MSG-FE03-07) 3. The row is listed under "Đã hủy" and no longer under "Đang chờ" 4. The link shows "Lời mời không còn hiệu lực" (MSG-FE03-08)
precondition: 1. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local in the ACTIVE 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Owner closes the cancel dialog with "Quay lại"
procedure: 1. On "Lời mời" → "Đang chờ" click "Hủy" on a pending row 2. Click "Quay lại"
expected_results: 1. The dialog closes; no toast 2. The invitation stays on "Đang chờ" and its link still opens
precondition: 1. A PENDING invitation exists (FE03-INT-01) 2. Signed in as owner@beefcare.local 3. Backend (profile dev,local), PostgreSQL, Mailpit and frontend (npm run dev:backend) are running

description: Farm not ACTIVE: the Owner can still cancel but not resend
procedure: 1. As pm@beefcare.local suspend 'BeefCare Local Farm A' 2. As owner@beefcare.local open "Lời mời" 3. Check "Gửi lại" on a pending row, then click "Hủy" → "Hủy lời mời"
expected_results: 1. Notice "Dịch vụ trại hiện không hoạt động. Bạn vẫn có thể xem và hủy lời mời đang chờ." 2. "Gửi lại" cannot be used (MSG-FE03-04) 3. Cancel succeeds with "Đã hủy lời mời."
